title: Expose the missing joint contexts despite known marginal lifetime laws
statement: The reviewed construction couples a baseline to a persistent uniformly selected hidden relation. A prepared episode reveals only a bounded expected number of informative position pairs, giving transcript TV<=2 E_0 N/(2^d-1); a uniformly accurate reusable predictor needs TV>=1/3 and hence E_0 N>=(2^d-1)/6.

requires: The stated symmetric nonnegative hidden-coloring source family and coarse access
Reusable simultaneous absolute predictor at the declared finite horizon and success probability
provides: A precise acquisition obstruction and equally informed exponential-scale upper comparison
assumptions: Controls adapt and episodes stop; actual preparation/access exclusions remain
Marginal repetition laws agree but consequential mixed words differ
costs: N counts preparations reaching an informative loss test; total preparations/applications are at least N
Disclosed-family relation testing pays(2^d-1) batches and H times that many primitive applications
contract.units: Expected informative preparations under baseline; total primitive applications; d and H=3d+2.
contract.obstruction: Learning each primitive lifetime law does not acquire the joint contexts needed for reusable mixed-word prediction.

evidence.quote: # A generic cost obstruction for reusable coarse composition models
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The source space is enormous and the norm gap decreases with d. Symmetric nonnegative kernels may have negative spectral modes; the positive-semidefinite-only/passive subclass remains open. Reversible motions and adaptive stopping are allowed; cloning/restoring destroyed samples or fresh preparation retaining a selected hidden coloring are outside the interface. The matched disclosed-family upper route has exponential acquisition too. This is a specific observation-family obstruction, not every simulator or physical device. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed independent producer lower-bound review. The conservative1/6 statement is preserved; its optional sharper coupling and exact small-case diagnostics remain in the source. No new correctness/novelty assessment by Capital.
